summary: On Day 14 of a new server, Mythic equipment dungeons unlock. Players should first clear all dungeon difficulties one by one to claim all first-time clear rewards. For gear farming, prioritize Grave of Curse and Grave of Rot for Precise Carnage (30% damage boost vs enemies with Defense Penalty) and Emperor's Might (25% damage boost at 100% HP) for main DPS heroes. Support heroes should be built with key Legendary support sets like Puppeteer's Inspiration or Three-Ears Emblem to boost team energy and damage.

heroes.name: Twitch
heroes.note: Great user of the Enwinding Flesh set to apply a 20% derivative damage increase mark on targets.

heroes.name: Serpentemis
heroes.note: Maximizes damage output when equipped with Precise Carnage or Emperor's Might while teammates enable debuffs.

tips: Clear each dungeon difficulty level one by one to harvest all first-time clear rewards before settling into farming.
Prioritize chest and glove farming in Grave of Curse or Grave of Rot for universal damage-boosting Mythic pieces like Precise Carnage.
Pair Precise Carnage gear with Defense Penalty artifacts like Witch's Remains or Mystical Conch for an easy 30% damage increase.
Equip at least one support hero with the 3-piece Puppeteer's Inspiration legendary set to grant 30% ultimate energy to same-element allies upon casting an ultimate.
Use the Three-Ears Emblem 3-piece legendary set on supports to grant all allies a 15% elemental damage increase for 10 seconds when using an ultimate skill.
Equip Lunar Radiance weapons in PvP and Fey Meander for a clutch 3-second immortality buff upon reaching 0 HP.
title: The BEST Mythic Gear to Farm Early! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
